message.content:
Here are two ways to show the work:

**Method 1: Standard Multiplication**
$$\begin{array}{r} 17 \\ \times 23 \\ \hline 51 \quad (3 \times 17) \\ 340 \quad (20 \times 17) \\ \hline 391 \end{array}$$

**Method 2: Distributive Property**
$$17 \times 23 = 17 \times (20 + 3)$$
$$= (17 \times 20) + (17 \times 3)$$
$$= 340 + 51$$
$$= 391$$

**Answer:** 17 times 23 is **391**.
